explication: Terraform Core is a CLI for describing infrastructure, producing an execution plan, and applying changes. The principal workflow runs from configuration loading and dependency-graph evaluation through provider operations and state updates; the graph also supports parallel work for independent resources. The README establishes the plan/graph/apply capabilities, while sampled sources show the CLI and a query-specific path for discovering remote infrastructure and evaluating policies. Several runtime subsystems are represented by their enclosing directories because their implementation was not sampled.
